later the better approach was 
The shortcut: instead of counting inside the range, do two easy counts from the start of the street and subtract.

Count all the odd houses from house 1 up to high.
Count all the odd houses from house 1 up to just before low.
Subtract the second from the first. What's left is the odd houses in your range.
